teaser: One version of you is mid-sentence, already drawing the room in. Another version of you is checking, for the third time, whether everyone got home safe. Life path 3 gave you the first impulse — the pull toward color, toward saying the thing out loud, toward lighting a room up just by walking into it. ESFJ gives you the second — the instinct to hold the room together once it's lit. Put the two in one person and the gift and the duty start sharing a single nervous system. The sparkle isn't separate from the care; it's bait for it to work at all.
